domain_title: Purpose, value, context, roles and classification
title: Undefined or elastic intended purpose
canonical_definition: Purpose is vague, technically framed, inconsistent, or expands without controlled requalification.
failure_mechanism: Ambiguous purpose permits uncontrolled requirements, data use and deployment boundaries.

conditions: Applies to every assessed AI solution.

primary_questions.question: Is the declared purpose vague, inconsistent or missing material use boundaries?
Do implemented or operational uses materially diverge from the declared purpose?
Has a scoped current comparison tested declared and actual uses for divergence?

atomic_tests.test: Test whether the purpose record contains users, outcomes and explicit use boundaries.
Compare declared, implemented and operational uses across the assessed boundary.

required_evidence.title: Purpose record
required_evidence.description: Attributable declared purpose and explicit use boundaries.

required_evidence.title: Purpose comparison
required_evidence.description: Scoped comparison of declared, implemented and operational uses.

sufficiency: All material use paths must be compared with the approved purpose.
evidence_rules.evidence_ceiling: Silence or a single document cannot establish tested absence of purpose drift.
false_positive_guards: Editorial naming differences alone do not prove purpose drift.
prohibited_inferences: Do not infer tested absence from a single README or purpose statement.

conditions: Purpose is undefined or materially inconsistent at deployment.

normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: Defines the organizational purpose and ownership record.

finding_definitions.title: Purpose is undefined or materially inconsistent
